import os, csv, psycopg2
from slugify import slugify
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import logging
import time
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from importing_script.qmd import main
# I am also enabling logging for us to see how the script is behaving and identify potential errors in script
logging.basicConfig(
    filename="./logs/cleaning_inserting_db.log",
    level=logging.DEBUG,
    format="%(asctime)s-%(levelname)s-%(message)s",
    filemode='a'
)

from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

user = os.getenv("PGUSER")
pwd  = os.getenv("PGPASSWORD")
host = os.getenv("PGHOST")
port = os.getenv("PGPORT")
db   = os.getenv("PGDATABASE")



engine = create_engine(f"postgresql+psycopg2://{user}:{pwd}@{host}:{port}/{db}")


def create_vendor_summary(engine):
    '''This function will merge the different tables to get the overall vendor summary and adding new columns to the resultant data.'''

    vendor_sales_summary=pd.read_sql_query("""
    with freight_summary as (
        select
        vendor_number,
        sum(freight) as freight_cost
        from stg.vendor_invoice
        group by vendor_number),
        purchase_summary as (
        select
            p.vendor_number::text as vendor_number,
            p.vendor_name,
            p.brand,
            p.description,
            p.purchase_price,
            pp.list_price as Actual_price,
            pp.volume,
            sum(p.quantity) as total_purchase_quantity,
            sum(p.dollars) as total_purchase_dollars
        from stg.purchases as p
        inner join stg.purchase_prices as pp
            on p.brand=pp.brand
        where p.purchase_price>0
        group by p.vendor_number, p.vendor_name, p.brand, p.description, p.purchase_price, pp.list_price, pp.volume
        ),
        sales_summary as (
        select
            vendor_number::text as vendor_number,
            brand,
            sum(sales_quantity) as total_sales_quantity,
            sum(sales_dollars) as total_sales_dollars,
            sum(sales_price) as total_sales_price,
            sum(excise_tax) as total_excise_tax
        from stg.sales
        group by vendor_number, brand
        )
        select
        ps.vendor_number,
        ps.vendor_name,
        ps.brand,
        ps.description,
        ps.purchase_price,
        ps.actual_price,
        ps.volume as ,
        ps.total_purchase_quantity,
        ps.total_purchase_dollars,
        ss.total_sales_quantity,
        ss.total_sales_dollars,
        ss.total_sales_price,
        ss.total_excise_tax,
        fs.freight_cost
        from purchase_summary as ps
        left join sales_summary as ss
        on ps.vendor_number= ss.vendor_number
        and ps.brand=ss.brand
        left join freight_summary as fs
        on ps.vendor_number=fs.vendor_number
        order by ps.total_purchase_dollars Desc
    """, engine)
    end=time.time()
    print(f"time taken to execute: {end-start}")
    return vendor_sales_summary


def clean_data(df):
    '''THis function is going to create the extra columns.'''


    vendor_sales_summary['gross_profit']=vendor_sales_summary['total_sales_dollars']-vendor_sales_summary['total_purchase_dollars']

    vendor_sales_summary['gross_profit'].min()
    vendor_sales_summary['profit_margin']= (vendor_sales_summary)['gross_profit']*100/vendor_sales_summary['total_sales_dollars']
    vendor_sales_summary['stock_turnover']=(vendor_sales_summary['total_sales_quantity'])/(vendor_sales_summary)['total_purchase_quantity']
    vendor_sales_summary['sales_to_purchase_ratio']=vendor_sales_summary['total_sales_dollars']/vendor_sales_summary['total_purchase_dollars']


    return df

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
    logging.info('creating vendor_sales_summary Table....')
    summary_df=create_vendor_summary(engine)
    logging.info(summary_df.head())

    logging.info('cleaning data and appending data...')
    clean_df=clean_data(summary_df)
    logging.info(clean_df.head())

    logging.info('ingesting data....')

    main(clean_df, 'vendor_sales_summary',engine)
    logging.info('completed')
